about: Op art from pattern fields: line weights driven by distance from the centre and time (Bridget Riley-style swelling bands), a dot field modulated by a travelling sine, and waves whose amplitude falls across the box. One "field" expression per layer (u v x y d a r t). Only one value per mark changes, so it stays graphic, and with t in the field it moves. Keep spacing ≥ 6 px (finer turns to moiré after H.264) and avoid fast high-contrast flicker (photosensitivity: under 3 flashes a second).
cost: ~3 s for 4 s (1080p; live fields regenerate each frame, 46 fps)
